title: Maintaining P-Trap Water Seal Integrity
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when traps lose this seal due to siphonage, evaporation, or thermal expansion. To ensure reliable performance, always install P-traps with proper venting to prevent negative air pressure from pulling water out of the trap seal during discharge. In floor drains or rarely used fixtures, consider trap primers or approved seal barrier devices to combat evaporation. Keeping trap seals intact protects indoor air quality and maintains proper drainage system pressure balance.

Maintaining P-Trap Water Seal Integrity

A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when traps lose this seal due to siphonage, evaporation, or thermal expansion. To ensure reliable performance, always install P-traps with proper venting to prevent negative air pressure from pulling water out of the trap seal during discharge. In floor drains or rarely used fixtures, consider trap primers or approved seal barrier devices to combat evaporation. Keeping trap seals intact protects indoor air quality and maintains proper drainage system pressure balance.
